description: This file defines a mock class for the IDecryptionService interface used in testing. It includes mock methods for decrypting media, checking key system type, selecting key IDs, and managing session ID usage counters, within the firebolt::rialto::server namespace.

classes.name: DecryptionServiceMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IDecryptionService interface for unit testing purposes.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Mocks the decrypt method with different parameter sets for testing.

methods.name: isPlayreadyKeySystem
methods.description: Mocks the method to check if the key system is PlayReady.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Mocks the method to select a key ID based on session ID.

methods.name: incrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Mocks the method to increment the usage counter for a session ID.

methods.name: decrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Mocks the method to decrement the usage counter for a session ID.
